topic: Octopus biology: hearts, blood, arms, taste, color
hook: 5 things octopuses do that seem impossible
caption:
Octopuses have three hearts, blue blood and arms that can taste. They look less like animals from Earth and more like visitors from another planet.

One of the strangest details: about two-thirds of their neurons sit in their arms, so each arm can explore and react on its own.
